objectives.text: Separate a Spring Boot feature into controller, service and repository layers so that the controller holds no business rule and no repository call
Expose the API only through request and response DTO records, mapped from entities in one mapper
Serve a paged and sorted listing whose response content and page metadata pass the public tests run with mvn -q -o test

Build time is project time inside the calendar day's build block (S6 Build 80, FT5/FT7 guided block 85), recorded in the coding lab's lab.json, not in this budget; the teach phase (the day's own pages and checks, before the scaffold opens) and the build are timed inside that block (authoring/evidence/spring-boot/intake.md, Project-artifact plan). The spring-data-jpa module PR measures the authored brief and raises budget and aboutLabel to at least ceil(max(P50, modeledWorstPath)), at most 15.
